description: Seed messages for the adversarial robustness corpus. bench/obfuscate.ts applies every obfuscation technique to every seed deterministically. The `dev` seeds were used while developing the normalizer; the `holdout` seeds were written afterwards and are only used for reporting. Written for this repository; MIT licensed.
